name: Jackson Lippert
headline: Software developer
summary: Software developer at RBC with a Software Engineering degree from McMaster University. Outside work I'm building a couch co-op game in Godot and a model of how people with perfect pitch identify notes. Before that I did nine hackathons and engineering competitions, and placed third in three of them.

points: Built an API to replace a robotic process automation workflow, saving $4,000 a year.
Created an extract-load-transform layer for hundreds of daily transactions.
Automated onboarding for new RBC Trust clients, saving a day per client.
Presented a cloud migration plan to the infrastructure platform team that shaped RBC Investor Services' development plans.
Became the sole quality engineer on an agile Scrum team, taking over from my supervisor and testing more than 250 tickets.
Automated and documented API tests with REST Assured and Selenium, cutting regression testing time by 20%.
Grew automated test coverage by 15% as the application expanded.
Led performance testing that cut network-call load times by more than 50%.
